properties.name: CATA Rydz
properties.note: Two on-demand zones, each a subset of its municipality, not full boundaries: Lansing zone bounded by Old Town (north), Mt Hope Hwy (south), Pennsylvania Ave (east), Waverly Rd south of St. Joseph Hwy (west); Delta Township zone bounded by I-496 (north), Millwood Hwy (south), Waverly Rd (east), Nixon Rd/Canal Rd (west). Late-night zone connects the two; airport service (CATA Rydz Connect) serves trips within these same two zones. Source: https://www.cata.org/services/cata-rydz

properties.name: Metro Link (Kalamazoo Metro)
properties.units: Comstock charter township; Portage city; Oshtemo charter township; Texas charter township
properties.note: Three zones, not countywide: East zone covers Comstock Township, South zone covers Portage, West zone covers Oshtemo Township and parts of Texas Township. No exact zone boundaries or size published; townships shown here are approximate containing units, not full zone extent. Sources: https://www.wmuk.org/wmuk-news/2024-04-18/kalamazoo-metro-launches-a-rideshare-service, https://comstockmi.gov/2024/04/01/new-ridesharing-service-to-launch-in-comstock-charter-township/, https://city.ridewithvia.com/metrolink

properties.name: MTA Genesee Connect
properties.units: Flint city; Grand Blanc city; Mundy township
properties.note: First zone (launching July 2026) is the Hill Rd. Corridor, a linear corridor, not full coverage of any of these units. MTA's own page says the zone is 'located in Flint and Grand Blanc' (city of Grand Blanc used here; township boundary is ambiguous in Census data and unresolvable from the source text); coverage of the ribbon-cutting event (at the Mundy Township Senior Center on Hill Rd) also names Mundy Township as a stop area. No zone size, radius, or boundary streets published; more zones planned. Sources: https://www.mtaflint.org/genesee-connect/, https://midmichigannow.com/news/local/mta-introduces-the-new-micro-transit-service-in-genesee-county

properties.name: Ogemaw County Public Transportation

properties.name: ROSCOTA
properties.note: Roscommon County service for residents and visitors, with medical connections to neighboring/downstate counties.
